description: Liste des connexions sur les points d'accès publics Wifi de la Ville de Lisieux is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Lisieux. Export of data from January 2019 to August 2019. The dataset presents the list of connections per user spread over the 24 hours of the day. Coverage: Ville de Lisieux. The portal shows the English title as "List of connections on public Wi-Fi access points in the City of Lisieux" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Lisieux. Its keywords include hotspot, wifi-territorial, wifi-lisieux, wifi, connexions-wifi. The listing shows 6 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2019-09-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
